longDesc: Compétence spécifique à un général. « Expeditionary Force Commander » monte jusqu'au niveau 5. Au niveau maximum (5), elle applique l'effet suivant : « Lorsque vous commandez des unités navales, gain +5 mobility and unaffected by effect that disable counterattack. When commanding unités, augmenter 5% attaque and counterattack dégâts for every 3 mobility. ». Signature propre à un général : son niveau maximum conditionne la valorisation de la carte.
longDescEn: A general-specific skill. "Expeditionary Force Commander" scales up to level 5. At max level (5), the skill applies the following effect: "When commanding ship units, gain +5 mobility and unaffected by effect that disable counterattack. When commanding units, increase 5% attack and counterattack damage for every 3 mobility.". A general-specific signature: its max level drives the card's overall value.
